messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "talk with your healthcare provider about the benefits of breastfeeding alongside your need for this medicine"
set: ["talk with your healthcare provider about the benefits of breastfeeding alongside your need for this medicine", "talk with doctor about benefits of breastfeeding and treatment need", "talk with your doctor about this risk", "call your healthcare provider if this happens", "talk to your healthcare provider about how you can take part in this registry", "discuss benefits and risks of treatment with healthcare provider", "talk with your doctor about the best way to feed your baby", "talk to healthcare provider if breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed", "talk with your doctor if increased need for medication in 24-hour period", "talk to your doctor if this occurs", "your medicine comes with directions for properly cleaning your device", "talk with your doctor about the best way to feed your baby if you are taking Carvedilol", "healthcare provider", "take exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider", "inform healthcare provider about liver problems", "inform healthcare provider about thyroid problems"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
